mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% annualized, it indicates a monetary tightening cycle with a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, it indicates accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL growth > 2%.
